## Problem measured (2026-10-06, review profile, 88 models)

46 models had no context evidence and ran on the catch-all placeholder (`modelMatch: ".*"`:
200K, text-only, tools on); all OpenCode, Kimi CLI and Antigravity models were among them. Vision
was missing for Gemini/Claude via Antigravity and for every ACP model, because the ACP catalog
wrote `supportsImage: false` whenever a CLI was silent, outranking everything below it. Image and
video generators on ordinary OpenAI-compatible hosts were listed as chat models.

## Design (candidate 0164)

| Layer, lowest first | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Catch-all placeholder | `zcode-builtin.json` `.*` | Unchanged; now only for models nobody knows. |
| **Catalog** | `packages/provider/src/model-knowledge.generated.ts` | Generated by `scripts/generate-model-knowledge.mjs` from the catalog that the installed `@earendil-works/pi-ai` already ships (MIT; models.dev/OpenRouter-derived): 840 models, 40 hosts. Context, max output, image input, image output. |
| Curated rules | `zcode-builtin.json` model/API/site rules | Includes new output-type patterns for video, image, speech, transcription and embedding models. |
| Provider facts | discovery / native catalogs | Write only what the route states. |
| Saved and manual corrections | personal rules | Always win. |

Lookup normalises ids (vendor path, case, `4.6`≡`4-6`, `-thinking`/date variants) and chooses the
entry of the serving host — id prefix (`opencode-go/…`), template (ChatGPT → `openai-codex`, Kimi
CLI → `kimi-coding`) or longest matching base URL — then the model's vendor, then a cross-host
consensus (capabilities unioned as Cherry Studio does, limits by most common value). Reasoning
levels are not taken from the catalog: their values must map to request fields, which curated
rules own. The context badge names its source; `catalog` reads 模型目录 / Model catalog.

Result: placeholder contexts 46 → 1 (an unlisted preview model); the live OpenCode list shows
1M/1.05M/500K/256K per model and vision only where its host accepts images.

Output types: naming classifies generators so they leave the chat picker; execution remains exact
(`isOfficialOpenaiImageModel`, xAI catalogs). Media transports for other vendors (Seedream, Kling,
Wan, Veo, Hailuo, FLUX hosts) are not implemented; see [Media](media.md).

## Compared sources

| Project | Mechanism | Taken |
|---|---|---|
| OpenCode (`packages/core/src/models-dev.ts`) | models.dev `api.json`: build snapshot, disk cache (5 min), hourly refresh | Catalog shape and host-scoped entries; no network refresh yet |
| Cherry Studio (`packages/provider-registry`, AGPL) | Generated registry (937 models), capability enum incl. image/video generation, id normalisation, union merge, per-provider overrides | Design only; no data or code copied |
| Pi AI 1.0.2 (`models.generated.js`) | Static per-provider catalog with `thinkingLevelMap`, image catalog | Data source for the snapshot |

## Open

- Refreshing between releases would mean fetching models.dev at runtime (an external service:
  owner checkpoint). Until then the snapshot follows pi-ai upgrades; a test fails when they drift.
- Per-model reasoning levels for ACP CLIs (OpenCode applies one session list to every model).
- Media transports beyond OpenAI and xAI.
